description: Week 9 shared golden set for the two corpora that ship with rag-starter. It exists so the ablation in Module 9 has comparable numbers across the cohort, and so a thin Week-6 golden set never blocks Week 9. YOUR OWN golden set over YOUR OWN documents is still the one that matters -- this is the reference, not the replacement.

how_to_read_an_entry.corpus: which folder under data/ to index before asking this question
how_to_read_an_entry.history: earlier USER turns, oldest first. Non-empty means this is a follow-up.
how_to_read_an_entry.question: what the user actually types this turn
how_to_read_an_entry.expected_source: the file that can answer it; null means nothing in the corpus can
how_to_read_an_entry.expected_snippet: text that must appear in a retrieved chunk for the answer to be grounded; null for out-of-corpus questions
